stem: Voltmarkt's Business Care subscription (a monthly device-support plan for small offices) had €40,000 of MRR from its existing businesses at the start of a 12-month window. Over the window those businesses cancelled €3,000 of MRR, downgraded €1,000 and upgraded €6,200. New businesses added €9,000 of MRR. What is the net revenue retention for the window? Give a percentage with 1 decimal.
